summary.text: Anthony Forlini is the Republican nominee for Michigan Secretary of State and has been Macomb County clerk since 2021. A former Harrison Township supervisor and state representative, he is campaigning on cleaner voter rolls, shorter Secretary of State wait times and more election transparency.

paragraphs.text: Forlini earned a bachelor's degree from Western Michigan University in 1984 and has worked as a Certified Financial Planner.
He was Harrison Township supervisor from 2004 to 2010.
Forlini then represented the 24th District in the Michigan House of Representatives starting in 2011; Votebeat dates his service to 2016, while Ballotpedia lists it as ending in 2017.
In 2016 he ran for Michigan's 10th Congressional District and finished fourth of five candidates in the Republican primary.
He was elected Macomb County clerk in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.
Republicans nominated him for secretary of state at their August 22 convention.
